sundai:fc:156.question: The nation's education system needs a great _____ (機関、制度).
sundai:fc:156.fullSentence: The nation's education system needs a great institution to support it.
sundai:fc:156.explanation: institution: 機関、制度。constitution: 憲法、構成。

sundai:fc:157.question: 「迷信」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:157.fullSentence: Breaking a mirror is considered a bad superstition.

sundai:fc:158.question: Kyoto is one of the most popular travel _____ in Japan.
sundai:fc:158.fullSentence: Kyoto is one of the most popular travel destinations in Japan.

sundai:fc:159.question: 「妨げる」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:159.fullSentence: Heavy traffic impeded our progress to the airport.

sundai:fc:160.question: The army launched an _____ into the desert region.
sundai:fc:160.fullSentence: The army launched an expedition into the desert region.

sundai:fc:161.question: The area is popular with joggers and _____.
sundai:fc:161.fullSentence: The area is popular with joggers and pedestrians.

sundai:fc:162.question: He always looks on the dark side of things; he is very _____.
sundai:fc:162.fullSentence: He always looks on the dark side of things; he is very pessimistic.

sundai:fc:163.question: After the rain, there was a big _____ in the middle of the road.
sundai:fc:163.fullSentence: After the rain, there was a big puddle in the middle of the road.

sundai:fc:164.question: Please don't _____ me while I'm speaking.
sundai:fc:164.fullSentence: Please don't interrupt me while I'm speaking.
sundai:fc:164.explanation: interrupt: 中断する。rupt「壊す」語根。

sundai:fc:165.question: 「突然の」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:165.explanation: abrupt: 突然の。corrupt: 堕落した。erupt: 噴火する。bankrupt: 破産した。

sundai:fc:166.question: The volcano could _____ again at any moment.
sundai:fc:166.fullSentence: The volcano could erupt again at any moment.
sundai:fc:166.explanation: erupt: 噴火する。eruption: 噴火。

sundai:fc:167.question: Political _____ is a serious problem in many countries.
sundai:fc:167.fullSentence: Political corruption is a serious problem in many countries.

sundai:fc:168.question: The government's poor policies could lead to social _____.
sundai:fc:168.fullSentence: The government's poor policies could lead to social disruption.

sundai:fc:169.question: The country needs to improve its transportation _____.
sundai:fc:169.fullSentence: The country needs to improve its transportation infrastructure.

sundai:fc:170.question: The company needs a new marketing _____ to survive.
sundai:fc:170.fullSentence: The company needs a new marketing strategy to survive.

sundai:fc:171.question: She always _____ to do her best in everything.
sundai:fc:171.fullSentence: She always strives to do her best in everything.

sundai:fc:172.question: 「強制する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:172.fullSentence: The law compels drivers to wear seatbelts.
sundai:fc:172.explanation: compel: 強制する。dispel: 追い払う。expel: 追放する。repel: 退ける。

sundai:fc:173.question: The school decided to _____ the student for cheating.
sundai:fc:173.fullSentence: The school decided to expel the student for cheating.

sundai:fc:174.question: In many countries, military service is _____ for young men.
sundai:fc:174.fullSentence: In many countries, military service is compulsory for young men.

sundai:fc:175.question: He bought the car on _____ , without thinking it through.
sundai:fc:175.fullSentence: He bought the car on impulse, without thinking it through.

sundai:fc:176.question: The government will _____ the exact cause of the accident.
sundai:fc:176.fullSentence: The government will determine the exact cause of the accident.
sundai:fc:176.explanation: determine: 決定する。term「境界」語根。

sundai:fc:177.question: Scientists are trying to _____ this dangerous virus completely.
sundai:fc:177.fullSentence: Scientists are trying to exterminate this dangerous virus completely.

sundai:fc:178.question: 「~を受け入れる」の表現はどれ？
sundai:fc:178.fullSentence: It took years for her to come to terms with the loss.
sundai:fc:178.explanation: come to terms with: ~を受け入れる。

sundai:fc:179.question: Public _____ began to shift against the war.
sundai:fc:179.fullSentence: Public sentiment began to shift against the war.
sundai:fc:179.explanation: sentiment: 感情、意見。sent「感じる」語根。

sundai:fc:180.question: 「同意する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:180.fullSentence: Both parents must consent before the surgery.
sundai:fc:180.explanation: consent: 同意する。assentも同意する。resent: 憤慨する。scent: 匂い。
